ترتجلن (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجِلْنَ (tartajilna) /tar.ta.d͡ʒil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# تُرْتَجَلْنَ (turtajalna) /tur.ta.d͡ʒal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
